A '''professor''' was an individual teaching at a university level.

"Associate Professor of Xenolinguistics" was a title held by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Milanda Vorgan]], author of "[[The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic]]." She held the title while teaching at the [[University of Charmath]].

The term "professor" can also be used as an insult, such as when giving advice when it is already obvious. This type of usage was especially prevalent with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], where he sarcastically referred to [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] as such when the latter mentioned that the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]]'s ground was unstable.<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>
